worldTagline: Survive the snowy night · Keep the last torch lit

regionToasts.camp_edge: Snow weighs down the pines. The campfire still burns behind you.
regionToasts.frozen_brook: Ice cracks along the frozen brook. The shallows have become a cold bog.
regionToasts.burnt_caravan: Charred ruts disappear into the snow. Burnt resin still hangs in the air.
regionToasts.old_mill: The millwheel has long since stopped, yet iron still scrapes across the floor inside.
regionToasts.deep_woods: The wind falls quiet in the deep woods. Footsteps sound between the branches.
regionToasts.herbalist_hollow: Low mist gathers beneath the dead pines. The stone mortar still smells of herbs.
regionToasts.ice_gorge: The gorge wind skitters shards of ice past your feet.
regionToasts.blackened_outpost: The blackened outpost stands silent. A faint light moves in the dark.
regionToasts.frost_ridge: The tree line ends at your feet. The old beacon lies farther east.
regionToasts.beacon: Snow hides generations of firekeepers' marks on the stone platform.

first_ember_seal.title: The Ember Seal's Warmth
first_ember_seal.body: The Mill Spider pauses before firing its silk. One step sideways is enough to dodge it. The Ember Seal still feels warm in my hand.

ember_dust_note.title: Embers in the Snow
ember_dust_note.body: The Ember Dust stayed warm long after it landed in the snow. Suheng says we can follow it to the old fire patrol route.

beacon_restored.title: The Beacon Relit
beacon_restored.body: The beacon's light crossed the snowy ridge. At the foot of the mountain, one house after another lit its lamps.

dead.title: The Fire Goes Out
dead.epilogue: Snow covered the path home. The unsent camp notes remained by the fire.

storm_lost.title: The Storm Arrives
storm_lost.epilogue: The storm buried the silent beacon. The people below left one last lamp in the window.

won.title: The Beacon Rekindled
won.epilogue: The two Ember Seals joined in the stone platform. The firelight crossed the Frost Abyss. Those who had waited all night opened their doors and saw the way home.
